title: 진료비 영수증 읽기: 나는 얼마를 냈어요?
objective: You can read a Korean medical receipt (진료비 영수증) and find the visit date, the total cost, and the amount you pay.
summary: Learners read a Korean clinic receipt and find the date, the fees, and what the patient pays.
note: The clinic, the patient, and all the amounts on this receipt are made up for practice.

task.title: Read and find the information
task.line: Read each receipt part. Then write the answer, choose a word, or answer Yes or No.

sections.heading: A real-style receipt: 진료비 영수증
paragraphs: 환자 성명: 마리아 가르시아 | 진료과: 내과 | 진료 기간: 2026. 10. 05. ~ 2026. 10. 05.
진료비 총액: 40,000원 | 환자부담 총액: 19,000원 | 납부한 금액: 19,000원 (카드)

items.text: This shows the day you saw the doctor.
items.example: 진료 기간을 보면 병원에 간 날을 알 수 있어요.

items.text: This is the money for seeing and talking to the doctor.
This is the money for tests, like a blood test.
This is the money for a shot.
This is the part of the insured cost that you pay.
National health insurance pays this part, not you.
Insurance does not help with this, so you pay all of it.
This is all the money for the visit, including the insurance part.
This is the full amount the patient must pay.

sections.heading: Reading tip: three money lines
paragraphs: Look at three lines at the bottom. 진료비 총액 = all three columns. 환자부담 총액 = 본인부담금 + 비급여 (in the receipt above: 9,000 + 10,000 = 19,000). 공단부담금 is not your money.
납부한 금액 is what you already paid. If it is smaller than 환자부담 총액, you still need to pay the rest.

exercises: Read and write the visit date (month and day) in English: 환자 성명: 왕리 | 진료과: 내과 | 진료 기간: 2026. 09. 22. ~ 2026. 09. 22.
Find the 환자부담 총액: 본인부담금 합계 6,500원 | 공단부담금 합계 15,000원 | 비급여 합계 4,000원
Answer Yes or No: ① 비급여는 건강보험 공단이 내는 돈이에요. ② 공단부담금은 환자가 병원에 내는 돈이에요. ③ 납부한 금액은 내가 병원에 낸 돈이에요.
Choose the right word (진찰료 / 검사료 / 주사료): ① 의사 선생님을 만나서 이야기했어요. → ____ ② 피 검사를 했어요. → ____ ③ 팔에 주사를 맞았어요. → ____
Answer in Korean with a number: 환자부담 총액은 15,000원이에요. 납부한 금액은 10,000원이에요. 얼마를 더 내야 해요?
answers: ① No ② No ③ Yes
① 진찰료 ② 검사료 ③ 주사료
